subject: VP pre-brief window — compressing demo to match Marcus' arrival
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Wong <elaine.wong@nimbus-fin.com>, Matt Barrow <matt.barrow@nimbus-fin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Proposed demo time w/ Nimbus — week of Oct 4

Hi Elaine / Matt,

Thanks again for your time today. Per our call, we'd like to schedule an interactive demo of Redwood for the Payments platform team. Proposed slot: Tue, Oct 6 at 10:00 AM PT (60 minutes).

Agenda (60m):
- 0–30m: Live product walkthrough (low-latency routing, model variants)
- 30–50m: Technical deep-dive (KV caching, batching strategy)
- 50–60m: Next steps & procurement checklist

If Marcus (VP Eng) wants to attend, we can prioritize the high-level business/SLAs first. Would you be able to confirm whether 10/6 works or if Marcus needs a different window?

I'll attach the short deck and send a calendar hold once we lock the time.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck-v3.pdf (18 pages, speaker notes)

From: Elaine Wong <elaine.wong@nimbus-fin.com>

Cc: Marcus Reed <m.reed@nimbus-fin.com>, Matt Barrow <matt.barrow@nimbus-fin.com>

Subject: Re: Proposed demo time w/ Nimbus — week of Oct 4

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the agenda. Quick heads up: Marcus asked to join but he'll be flying into SF on the morning of Oct 6; his ETA is 9:15 AM and he has a board prep call at 11:00. He prefers a single consolidated slot where we cover the executive-level outcomes first, then hand to engineering.

Marcus asked if we can either:
- move to Fri, Oct 9 at 8:30 AM PT (he lands earlier that morning and can make a condensed window), or
- keep the October 6 meeting but compress to a 40–45 minute briefing so he can join the first portion before his call.

Also looping Sarah Kim from procurement for contract/term questions later in the thread.

Would Redwood be able to compress the presentation & still show the latency/cost tradeoffs?

- Elaine
Elaine Wong
Director, Platform Partnerships | Nimbus Financial
elaine.wong@nimbus-fin.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Cc: Elaine Wong <elaine.wong@nimbus-fin.com>, Matt Barrow <matt.barrow@nimbus-fin.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposed demo time w/ Nimbus — compressing for Marcus' window

Ben / Priyom — forwarding Elaine's note. Marcus can only commit a short window (lands ~9:15 on 10/6) or prefers Fri 10/9 08:30. We need a pragmatic plan so we don't lose exec alignment:

Option A (preferred): Fri 10/9 08:30–09:15 PT (45m) — first 20m executive brief (value, SLOs, risk/fallbacks), 20m tech deep-dive, 5m next steps. Marcus can join first 20.

Option B: Tue 10/6 10:00–10:45 PT (45m compressed) — Marcus joins first 20, then hand off.

I propose we: compress slides (move case studies to appendix), focus on single vertical (payments fraud), and keep the live demo to 12 minutes max. Ben — can you tighten the demo flow and mark the slides that must be shown? Priyom — can you prepare the 2-slide SLA & pricing summary that Marcus will want to see early?

I'll attach the updated deck and a calendar-invite stub to send once we have confirmation. We should also add a backup: have Marcus dial in for the first 20 and let us record the rest for the engineering team.

Thanks — Vanessa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Wong <elaine.wong@nimbus-fin.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed demo time w/ Nimbus — compressing for Marcus' window

Vanessa — good call. I can shorten the live portion as follows:
- 0–12m: demo of live inference on a payments example (highlight routing & failover)
- 12–25m: high-level architecture & cost tradeoffs (for Marcus)
- 25–42m: technical deep-dive + Q&A (for engs)
- 42–45m: immediate next steps and action items

I'll strip two demo scenarios and move them to the appendix. Priyom — happy to work with you on the 2-slide SLA/pricing that sits at 12–14m.

If Elaine confirms Oct 9 at 08:30 PT, I'll produce a slim deck by EOD Oct 4 and we can push the calendar hold. If they want Oct 6 compressed, same deck applies but we need to shift timing.

Ben

Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
